description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint class CatalogItemGetByIdEndpoint that handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve catalog item details by ID from a repository, formats the response including image URI composition, and returns the appropriate HTTP response.

classes.name: CatalogItemGetByIdEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint class for retrieving catalog item details by ID, implementing IEndpoint, with route setup and request handling logic.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the API route '/api/catalog-items/{catalogItemId}' for GET requests, mapping it to the handler method.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the request to retrieve a catalog item by ID from the repository, constructs a DTO response, and returns an HTTP result.
